# Template overview

```text
template/
  copier.yml
  backend/     # FastAPI + platform-kit (Jinja conditionals)
  frontend/    # Vite + ui-kit modules→features
  README.md
  HANDOFF.md
```

## Design goals

- One Copier source, two stacks
- Layout matrix without forking the template
- Protected baselines (`platform-kit`, `@aham/ui-kit`); product code in modules/features
- Enforcement: `dx check`, hooks, pre-commit, CI, **example drift**

## Conditional backend tree

Jinja folder names emit only what answers need:

- `packages/` when `has_kit_source`
- `contracts` when kit repo or Kafka
- `compose.yaml` / `infra/` unless `polyrepo_kit`
- `.moon` / `nx.json` when selected
- Redis service when `is_saas`
- AI packs when `claude` / `cursor` selected

## Frontend tree

Always: `apps/web`, `packages/ui-kit`, `nginx/` (production image), Copier injects `api_base_url`, `auth_mode`, `default_locale`, `project_name` into Jinja files.

See [Example drift](./example-drift.mdx) for how examples stay in sync.
